findings.heading: Approach and style / アプローチとスタイル
findings.proposition: The handbook is intended to be a living document.
findings.reader_consequence: The Japanese reader does not learn that the handbook is continuously updated, so they may treat the package choices as fixed and not expect or seek revised editions.

findings.heading: Editorial decisions / 編集上の決定事項
findings.proposition: The English outcome cell says data.table is covered by a single dedicated page while tidyverse is the general approach; the Japanese cell reads that tidyverse is used in the data.table-related chapters, which the English does not state.
findings.reader_consequence: The Japanese reader misreads the scope of data.table coverage and may expect data.table code throughout the handbook rather than in one page.

findings.heading: Editorial decisions / 編集上の決定事項
findings.proposition: The Japanese rationale states that dplyr group_by() is as important as tidyverse; the English states the choice is consistent with the handbook's emphasis on tidyverse.
findings.reader_consequence: The stated reason for choosing dplyr group_by() over stats aggregate() becomes an importance ranking rather than a consistency argument, so the reader cannot follow the editorial logic.

findings.heading: Editorial decisions / 編集上の決定事項
findings.proposition: The discussion page is at https://github.com/appliedepi/epirhandbook; the English gives https://github.com/appliedepi/epirhandbook_eng.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader who wants to propose a tool or disagree with an editorial decision is sent to a different repository than the English reader, so the message may not reach the maintainers of this handbook.
